paragraphs.text: Separate per-session model and reasoning effort controls for DeepSeek Harness subagents.
# DSH Subagent Model Picker
Choose a different model and reasoning effort for new subagents without changing the main conversati
fferent model and reasoning effort for new subagents without changing the main conversation's model.

- **Separate Sub: picker** beside the normal model picker.
- **Per-conversation settings**, with Inh

erited as the default.
- **Existing subagents keep their model**, including after continuation or re

start.
- **Immediate saves** and a read-only picker on child conversations.
**Version:** 0.1.0 · **License:** MIT
## Quick start
Requires DSH Web **0.1.2-rc.1**, Node **22.19+ in the 22.x line or 24+**, and npm/pnpm on PATH. The
clone option also requires Git. Run this on the machine where DSH runs, using its usual account and
also requires Git. Run this on the machine where DSH runs, using its usual account and environment.
1. From a directory where you want to keep the plugin, run in a Linux/macOS shell:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
2. Once active work finishes, restart your existing DSH instance and refresh its Web page. Look for
**Sub:** beside the main model picker.
This installs the tested **v0.1.0 release**. Keep the plugin directory in place because DSH links to
it. If your Web profile isn't named `web`, substitute its name in the command.
**Without Git:** Download the v0.1.0 source ZIP, extract it into a permanent directory, and open a t
erminal there. Run the commands above starting at npm run setup, then restart as described.
**Need PowerShell, a custom runtime path, or help?** See the installation guide.
## Usage
Open **Sub:** and choose a provider, model and supported reasoning effort. Changes save immediately
and affect **new subagents only**. **Inherited** keeps DSH's normal selection—usually the parent mod
el, but explicit model/provider options from a spawning tool still apply. An explicit Sub: selection
overrides those options.
Children with successfully saved bindings keep their captured model and effort across continuation a
nd restart. Newly created descendants use the owning root conversation's latest explicit policy, or
DSH's normal selection when it is Inherited. Children created before installation remain unmanaged.
Ordinary conversation forks have independent settings. Child conversation views are read-only. Save
and validation failures are shown rather than silently switching managed children to another model.
**Known limitation:** If a new child's initial binding save fails, restarting DSH can leave that chi
ld unmanaged and using DSH's normal model choice instead. Fix storage and create a new child; see re
using DSH's normal model choice instead. Fix storage and create a new child; see recovery guidance.
## Compatibility
Tested on **Linux with Node 22.22.3 / 24.19.0 and DSH 0.1.2-rc.1**. All 61 automated tests pass, inc
luding a real archive roundtrip. Setup checks the qualified native libraries rather than installing
another DSH/Cordis copy. macOS and Windows are not yet independently qualified.
This plugin controls standard in-process DSH subagents, not separate Codex or Claude CLI products. C
ross-model vision support needs separate qualification. See architecture and limitations.
## Documentation

- Installation, updates, removal and troubleshooting
- Privacy and stored data
- Architecture and li

fecycle
- Development and contributing
- Security reporting
- Changelog
The package identity is dsh-subagent-model-policy. No npm release is available from this project; do
not install an unrelated similarly named package. The package's private flag prevents accidental np
m publication, not GitHub visibility.
## Support
**Community project:** Maintained in spare time. Support and updates are provided on a best-effort b
asis. Bug reports and contributions are welcome, but response times and compatibility with future DS
H releases aren’t guaranteed.
## License
MIT. Upstream DSH UI attribution is preserved in NOTICE.
